data.name: Dinesh
data.gender_notes: Dinesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Dinesh is derived from two Sanskrit words: ‘dīna’ meaning ‘poor’ and ‘īśh’ meaning ‘God’. This name suggests that God is the giver of all that is needed for the wellbeing of a person. It signifies the blessings and grace of God. The name Dinesh carries the meaning “God's gift” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dinesh usually hope their child will grow to embody god's gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.

historical_references.reference: Dineshchandra Ghosh, a prominent Indian nationalist leader, was born on 30 May 1861 in Calcutta, British India. He was a leading figure in the Indian National Congress and is remembered for his role in the Indian independence movement. Dineshchandra Ghosh passed away on 23 April 1939.

Dinesh, a renowned musician and music composer in Indian classical music, was born on 31 December 1947 in Kolkata, India. He is best known for his fusion of Indian classical music with Western music, and has composed music for various films, documentaries, and television series. Dinesh continues to compose music and perform live concerts.
